content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge text does not weigh a chain-against-chain collision over a live pressed link; it rules there is no live link after the defender dropped the curse limb.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"against a link: whether K-C governs only when there is a live link being pressed, or also a limb already dropped; I read against a link as requiring a live link.","why":"The judge disposes of C4 because the challenged curse limb was dropped and no live link remains, not by requiring a single stating verse or weighing a live chain collision, so K-C is not violated."}
